prescribed_flow_warning: Flow imposed at hood; pressure requirement is diagnosed. This is not a validated fan operating point; real duct/filter losses absent.
rate_interpretation: Residential Chinese POA paper reports 1.1–2.2 mg/min per dish experiment; applying 1.8 per active burner and adding two sources is an engineering extrapolation, not a measured two-wok emission factor. 7.2 mg/min/head is prior commercial-kitchen CFD assumed oil-droplet reference, retained as separate high-loading scenario. These are sensitivity scenarios, not bounds/confidence intervals on all cooking emissions. POA includes organic aerosol rather than chemically measured pure grease.
primary_output: mg deposited per mg emitted; five independent monodisperse responses mixed by assumed mass-size distribution
time_step_note: Early opened-door pilot intervals used original maxCo3/maxDt0.05; long opened-door runs use maxCo6/maxDt0.1. Closed maxCo12/maxDt0.04. Native frame interval2s plus checkpoints. Full-event air timestep independence not demonstrated.
